description: In pkix-path-builder/src/lib.rs line 242, cycle detection compares SubjectPublicKeyInfoOwned using derived PartialEq, which is a full field comparison including AlgorithmIdentifier parameters. For RSA, one cert may have AlgorithmIdentifier{oid=rsaEncryption, params=NULL} while another has AlgorithmIdentifier{oid=rsaEncryption, params=absent}. Both represent the same key but the derived PartialEq returns false, so the cycle guard may fail to detect a loop across encoding-variant CA certs. In practice this is unlikely in production PKIs, but is a correctness gap against adversarially crafted pools. The validate_path.rs already documents this (spki_key_matches compares oid+key bytes only); the builder should use the same approach.
title: pkix-path-builder: cycle detection uses SPKI equality but SPKI PartialEq may accept RSA keys with vs without NULL params as unequal
